description: This file defines memory mapping functions for Git, providing implementations of git_mmap and git_munmap that handle memory allocation and cleanup with error checking, based on system call wrappers.

methods.name: void * git_mmap(void * start,size_t length,int prot,int flags,int fd,off_t offset)
methods.description: Allocates memory and maps a file region into memory with safety checks for proper usage.

methods.name: int git_munmap(void * start,size_t length UNUSED)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for the mapped region.

ctags.name: git_mmap
ctags.pattern: /^void *git_mmap(void *start, size_t length, int prot, int flags, int fd, off_t offset)$/
ctags.signature: (void * start,size_t length,int prot,int flags,int fd,off_t offset)
